nodes.name: Load Plex NAS config
nodes.notes: Reads stack.json without exposing secrets in execution data.

nodes.name: Validate Plex NAS config
nodes.notes: Validates the core Plex/Radarr/Sonarr configuration. Download clients are reconciled on their dedicated branch.

nodes.name: Read Plex Watchlist API
nodes.notes: One Plex Discover HTTP fetch sequence per execution. Requests up to 1000 items. Does not rescan Radarr/Sonarr.

nodes.name: Reconcile Plex Watchlist
nodes.notes: Uses persistent workflow state with initialized/seen/pending tracking. First run initializes state without dispatching media.

nodes.name: Process Radarr movie
nodes.notes: Processes only the received Plex item. Uses Radarr API timeouts and retries. No additional Plex request.

nodes.name: Finalize movie
nodes.notes: Marks the item as handled only after successful Radarr processing. Failed items are retried on the next scan.

nodes.name: Process Sonarr series
nodes.notes: Processes only the received Plex item. Uses monitored series/episodes and explicit download-client routing. No additional Plex request.

nodes.name: Finalize series
nodes.notes: Marks the item as handled only after successful Sonarr processing. Failed items are retried on the next scan.

nodes.name: qBittorrent healthcheck
nodes.notes: Independent branch. Reports UP/DOWN without failing the main workflow.

parameters.command:
LOCKDIR="/home/node/.n8n/.media-smart-import-v2.lock"
# Recover stale legacy empty locks only after a safety window.
if [ -d "$LOCKDIR" ]; then
  if [ -f "$LOCKDIR/pid" ]; then
    OLD_PID="$(cat "$LOCKDIR/pid" 2>/dev/null)"
    case "$OLD_PID" in
      ''|*[!0-9]*) ;;
      *) if ! kill -0 "$OLD_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
           rm -f "$LOCKDIR/pid"
           rmdir "$LOCKDIR" 2>/dev/null || true
         fi ;;
    esac
  elif [ -n "$(find "$LOCKDIR" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +3 -print 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    rmdir "$LOCKDIR" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
fi
if ! mkdir "$LOCKDIR" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo '{"service":"media-smart-importer","ok":false,"status":"SKIP_LOCKED","message":"Importer lock held; retry next cycle"}'
  exit 0
fi
echo "$$" > "$LOCKDIR/pid"
trap 'rm -f "$LOCKDIR/pid"; rmdir "$LOCKDIR" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

SCRIPT="/home/node/.n8n/synoplex-scripts/media-smart-importer-00d12036.js"
if [ ! -r "$SCRIPT" ] || ! node --check "$SCRIPT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '{"service":"media-smart-importer","ok":false,"status":"IMPORTER_SOURCE_INVALID_OR_UNREADABLE"}'
  exit 1
fi
node "$SCRIPT"

nodes.name: NAS - Import completed Radarr + Sonarr downloads
nodes.notes: Every 5 minutes: processes completed Radarr and Sonarr downloads. Seeder threshold: 10. Radarr imports/copies/moves. Sonarr only removes a torrent after all video files are proven imported and present in media/Series.

nodes.name: Watchlist removal?
nodes.notes: True = batch of items removed from the Watchlist. False = item still present and sent to normal Radarr/Sonarr processing.

nodes.name: Clean Watchlist removal
nodes.notes: Removes data from qBittorrent and Radarr/Sonarr only when no media has been imported and no associated torrent is complete. Completed downloads and existing media are protected.

nodes.name: Reconcile Radarr Sonarr download clients
nodes.notes: Reconciles Decypharr and qBittorrent in Radarr and Sonarr from stack.json. Categories: radarr/sonarr. Decypharr priority 1, qBittorrent priority 10.
